topic: Luffy's Gear 5 stamina limit is why he needs Loki to hurt Imu in 1193
title: Luffy Can't Beat Imu Alone (One Piece 1193)
description: In chapter 1193 Luffy and Loki hurt Imu together, and then Luffy ran out of stamina. Here's my read on why Oda keeps giving Luffy a partner. Is Imu the final boss, or does someone else wait behind him?
comment: Is Imu the final villain, or is someone above him? Pick a side.

lines.text: Luffy can't beat Imu alone, and chapter 1193 proves it.

shot.fallback: white haired Luffy facing a dark ruler

lines.text: Here's my read, and it's not about Luffy being weak.

shot.fallback: smiling hero in white cloud form

lines.text: In 1193, Luffy and Loki hit Imu with a combined attack. It actually hurt him.

shot.fallback: hero and giant prince striking a dark ruler

lines.text: Then Luffy ran out of stamina, right after.
Remember the first time he used Gear 5, back in Wano, chapter 1044?
It ends the same way. Huge power, then a body that gives out.
Here's the detail most people missed.

shot.fallback: giant prince with a dark scowl

lines.text: The hit worked because it was two people. Gear 5 alone did nothing like that.
Fans say Luffy just needs more training. Fair, but Oda keeps solving his fights with a partner.
Law and Kid in Wano, and now Loki. Every big fight has someone standing next to him.
So the real answer to Imu isn't a stronger Luffy. It's a bigger crew.

shot.fallback: pirate crew on a ship at sunrise

lines.text: Because Luffy can't beat Imu alone...

shot.fallback: white haired Luffy facing a dark ruler
